features: Reflex Memory Cache: Zero-latency navigation by caching successful UI click sequences and re-applying them without vision processing.
Multi-Agent Delegation: Spawns isolated background sub-agents to handle long-running web tasks parallel to the main conversation.
Continuous Dreaming: Background idle simulation loop that explores interfaces and learns new web skills while the system is inactive.
Agentic Vision Workflow: System-injected vision navigation for precise, popup-resilient application driving instead of blind keystrokes.
